welcome.title: 🚀 Welcome to Registry!
welcome.introduction: I’m delighted to welcome you here. This site was designed to help you easily manage the check-ins and check-outs of your participants at a youth camp.
welcome.option: For each project, you can create access profiles to give other users access to your project, manage their check-ins/check-outs, follow their activities and many other options.
welcome.invitations: You will find your project invitations by clicking on your name at the top right of the screen. You can accept or decline these invitations. If you accept, you will be able to use the access profile tied to the invitation to access the project.
welcome.begin: Let’s go! To get started, if you want to create your own project, click the “Create a project” button below. If you want to join an existing project, click the button below.
